title: Bank Deposit Volume Goodwill on Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Errors
content:
Cross-product benefit notice: customers who send through **Bank Deposit** receive a goodwill percentage when a **Mobile Wallet** transfer was credited to the wrong wallet.

**Bank Deposit goodwill.** The Bank Deposit goodwill on a wrong-wallet funding follows the principal of the customer's Bank Deposit payments collected in the last 12 calendar months, that is the amounts of their Bank Deposit funds-received entries in that window:

| Bank Deposit principal collected in the window (USD) | Bank Deposit goodwill |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 1.5 percent |
| at least 2000.00 and below 5000.00 | 0.75 percent |
| below 2000.00 | nothing |

**The window.** It is rolling: it holds the entries whose entry date lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today, the whole calendar months from a date to today being the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's.

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-04-20)
- Bank Deposit payments of 3000.00 on 2025-06-01 and 2000.00 on 2026-02-14: 5000.00 in the window, 1.5 percent.
- A payment collected on 2025-04-20 gives 12 whole months and falls outside the window; one collected on 2025-04-21 gives 11 and falls inside.
- 1999.99 in the window: nothing.
